findings.description: The customer-managed KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false, so the key material used to encrypt the logs bucket is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the blast radius if the key is ever compromised and violates CIS AWS Foundations guidance requiring rotation for customer-managed CMKs.

deletion_window_in_days is set to the minimum of 7 days, leaving a narrow window to cancel an accidental or malicious key deletion. Destroying this key permanently renders all data encrypted under it (the logs bucket) unrecoverable, so a longer window is a safeguard against destructive action.
